prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: TALKPIK AI auth throttle screen concept
Input image role: source screenshot is a reference for rate-limited public auth state only.
Primary request: Redesign 33-X-11-auth-error/rate-limited.
Direction: abuse-safe auth throttle screen.
Composition/framing: desktop 1280x900 edge-to-edge app UI screenshot only; no browser address bar, tabs, bookmarks bar, OS window title bar, device frame, or watermark. Center a compact recovery card with neutral icon, title about temporarily paused requests, countdown or retry-after summary, disabled retry CTA, secondary route to login/home, and a privacy-safe support note. Do not show technical cause details.
Style/medium: high-fidelity Ant Design Result/Card/Alert/Button UI, calm public auth page.
Color palette: Mist #f4f4f5 canvas, Snow #ffffff card, Fog #ececee info row, Ink text, Steel helper copy, Obsidian primary when enabled only.
Typography: Cosmica-like single sans font, compact and readable, no letter spacing.
Constraints: no raw query values, no provider messages, no exact internal retry_after implementation details beyond user-facing countdown; Korean UI text is visual direction only and not final copy source.
Avoid: browser chrome, OS frame, device frame, red alarm page, AI gradients, colorful buttons, stack traces, debug identifiers, watermark.
